newsitem.title: ITALY: Fujimori says Peru unemployment around 7.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Fujimori says Peru unemployment around 7.8 pct.

text.p: Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori said on Monday that unemployment was around 7.8 percent and still remained a problem for his government.
"We recognise that unemployment is one of the factors that we still haven't fully overcome," Fujimori told a news conference in Rome, where he was on a visit.
"Unemployment is now approximately 7.8 percent," he said.

His remarks contrasted with official statistics issued by the Labour Ministry in April, which said that the Peruvian jobless rate had fallen to 7.1 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 compared with 7.5 percent in the same period of 1995.
Fujimori said the underemployment rate was now around 45 percent. Government officials in April put it at 47 percent.
The president said he hoped his country's unemployment situation would improve through the promotion of investments and support for small and medium-sized businesses.

Fujimori added that legislation was before parliament to enable young people to enter the labour market. The government statistics released in April showed an unemployment rate among 14 to 24-year-olds of 13.5 percent.
